questions.prompt: What is the resistance of a 1000 W heater designed for 200 V?
An appliance draws 4.2 A. What is the smallest standard fuse to use from 3 A, 5 A, 13 A?
Explain how an earth wire and a fuse together protect someone from an electric shock if the metal case of a toaster becomes live.
questions.modelAnswer: If a fault makes the metal case live, current flows through the low-resistance earth wire to the ground instead of through a person touching it. This large current is much bigger than normal, so the fuse in the live wire melts (or the MCB trips) and cuts off the supply, leaving the case safe.
rubric: Earth wire gives a low-resistance path to ground
Fuse melts/MCB trips, cutting the supply
